Would you prefer to communicate on WeChat? Add us at RegentLettings. The property comprises two double bedrooms, a family bathroom, an en suite shower room, an exceptionally spacious open plan kitchen/reception room with the option of a third bedroom or home office, and a stunning roof terrace in excess of 1000 sq ft. Wembley Parade is just a 0.2 miles walk away from Wembley Park Station, which offers direct connections to Kings Cross, Liverpool Street, Paddington, London Bridge and Canary Wharf via Metropolitan and Jubilee lines. Also nearby is Wembley Central station, which is connected to the Bakerloo line, London Overground and National Rail, providing fast access to a wide variety of rail stations including Euston, Charing Cross and Paddington. Regent Property comply with the Tenant Fees Act 2019 and are members of The Property Ombudsman scheme. Our Client Money Protection is provided by the UKALA Total Loss CMP scheme.
